plain_english: Worshipped this, meditated this, pleased this — thus this rasa: by thousand streams, in you, my — O Bhava — may it grow.
sanskrit_cite: arcito 'yam ayaṃ dhyāta eṣa toṣita ity ayam rasaḥ srotaḥsahasreṇa tvayi me bhava vardhatām

plain_english: Bow to the self abode of intellect-lords' garland; to the Lord, to Sthāṇu, to you — serpent-sacrifice-thread-wearing.
sanskrit_cite: namo niḥśeṣadhīpatrimālālayamayātmane nāthāya sthāṇave tubhyaṃ nāgayajñopavītine

plain_english: Of ignorance-darkness, the one medicine: remembrance of you; O Bhava, by its giving let grace be done in me.
sanskrit_cite: ajñānatimirasyaikam auṣadhaṃ saṃsmṛtis tava bhava tattatpradānena prasādaḥ kriyatāṃ mayi

plain_english: Bow to Īśa, fulfiller of all human ends; to-be-offered — the homage even — whose here, of the wise?
sanskrit_cite: nama īśāya niḥśeṣapuruṣārthaprasādhakaḥ praṇantavyaḥ praṇāmo 'pi yadīya iha dhīmatām

plain_english: By the immersed in the terrible bhava-ocean, abode of suffering-fish — having obtained Śārva's devotion-jewel: what not conquered?
sanskrit_cite: magnair bhīme bhavāmbhodhau nilaye duḥkhayādasām bhakticintāmaṇiṃ śārvaṃ tataḥ prāpya na kiṃ jitam

plain_english: Of unobstructed, pairless, steady knowledge-wealth: to-be-known you are indeed — who even are these who know you, O Dhūrjaṭi?
sanskrit_cite: nirāvaraṇanirdvandvaniścalajñānasampadām jñeyo 'si kila ke 'py ete ye tvāṃ jānanti dhūrjaṭe

plain_english: Qualityless even — of quality-knowers the to-be-known, one conquers, the unborn; desireless even, by nature — who is desires' supreme fruit.
sanskrit_cite: nirguṇo 'pi guṇajñānāṃ jñeya eko jayaty ajaḥ niṣkāmo 'pi prakṛtyā yaḥ kāmanānāṃ paraṃ phalam

plain_english: For Śrī-jewel-nectar gain, labored where not by which gods? That milk-ocean lordship: yours alone, natural, O Lord.
sanskrit_cite: śrīratnāmṛtalābhāya kliṣṭaṃ yatra na kaiḥ suraiḥ tat kṣīrodadam aiśvaryaṃ tavaiva sahajaṃ vibho

plain_english: Bow — by devotion, for men's liberation, he blossoms: O Bhava, to you, O Protector — by remembrance and praise they give to Śambhu: bliss in bhava, in non-bhava.
sanskrit_cite: namo bhaktyā nṛṇāṃ muktyai bhavate bhava te 'vate smṛtyā nutyā ca dadate śambhave śaṃ bhave 'bhave

plain_english: All-knowing, all-doing, all you are — thus, of knowers: what knowable, what karma, O lord — for endlessness, offered by you?
sanskrit_cite: sarvajñaḥ sarvakṛt sarvam asīti jñānaśālinām vedyaṃ kiṃ karma vā nātha nānantyāya tvayārpyate
